text: Could the app post to LinkedIn by itself on Fridays?
author: Sipho

replies.text: No, on purpose: a person always copies a post across. The tool drafts, people publish.
replies.author: Tobias

text: Fewer posts about AI, please. Our buyers want to hear about crews and billing runs.
author: Lena

replies.text: Added a playbook rule: at most one AI angle a week, and only with a named process behind it.
replies.author: Tobias

text: The blog cards look too dark on the website. Can blogs use the light card style?
author: Priya

replies.text: Done. Blog pictures now default to the light style; LinkedIn keeps the green one.
replies.author: Tobias

text: Anything that names Osterby Utilities needs their sign-off first. Please hold those posts until Anouk confirms.
author: Jonas

text: Can the Friday digest show which posts led to an enquiry? I'd like that next to the weekly numbers, not in a separate report.
author: Mara

replies.text: The Measurement agent already ties enquiries to landing pages. I've asked Jarvis to add one line per enquiry to the digest from this Friday.
replies.author: Tobias
